description: Send Hermoso renders to the user's Canva: each is uploaded to their Canva Uploads and, for an IMAGE, opened as a new editable Canva design (Canva makes designs from images only; a video lands in Uploads to drag into any design). Pass Library ids (L0… from list_library), Hermoso render links, or any public https image/video link (upload_file turns a local file into one); optional title, folderId (list_canva_folder / create_canva_folder), asDesign:false for the upload only. Answers with each design's edit link. Free. Needs Canva connected (Settings > Connectors > Canva).

asDesign.description: default true: an image becomes a new design

urls.description: render links or any public https image/video link

name: send_to_canva
title: Send to Canva
